plan.title: SRC-CRE-040 — Uncatalogued product in single-stage RFQ

steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen requested by the case.
Switch the single-stage event type from the default RFP to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing is not blocked by a missing title.
Apply an RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Enter the catalogue product named in the setup flow.
Choose the requested catalogue product option.
Verify the product selection fills the default variant.
Attempt to replace the catalogue product with the nonexistent product from the case.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Commit a valid schedule so missing scheduling does not obscure the publish attempt.
Add the product-provided QA vendor audience required for a publish attempt.
Assert that the event cannot be published after the invalid product entry.
